jobs.title: Director, Data Governance
jobs.description:
Position Title:
Director, Data Governance

Position Type:
Regular - Full-Time

Grade:
Grade 07

Requisition ID:
44573

In every role, McCainers are ambitious, curious, and passionate about creating exceptional work experiences - together. With a customer-first mindset, we make doing business with McCain easy.

About The Role.

We are seeking an accomplished and pragmatic Director, Data Platform Governance
to join the Data & Analytics organization within Digital Technology. Reporting to the VP, Head of Data & Analytics, this role is responsible for governing McCain’s Enterprise Data Platform (EDP) and enabling a trusted, certified, secure, and scalable data ecosystem that supports enterprise transformation, operational excellence, advanced analytics, and AI-enabled decision-making.

As the Digital Technology leader for Data Platform Governance, you will establish and continuously improve governance capabilities across the Enterprise Data Platform, ensuring certified data is consistently leveraged, platform controls are maintained, and metadata, lineage, traceability, data quality, and governance standards are embedded across the enterprise data landscape.

What You’ll Be Doing.

Lead governance strategy, standards, and operating practices for McCain’s Enterprise Data Platform and certified data consumption model.
Establish and maintain platform-level controls, metadata, lineage, traceability, catalog, and data product governance capabilities.
Partner with Business Transformation, Data Product Owners, architects, and delivery teams to embed governance standards and certified data consumption practices.
Provide leadership for governance tooling, including SAP MDG/SimpleMDG, metadata management, catalog, lineage, data quality, automation, bots, and AI-enabled services.
Ensure governance platforms are integrated across SAP, EDP, enterprise applications, analytics platforms, and downstream consumption layers.
Enable enterprise-wide data quality monitoring, controls, scorecards, issue management, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Establish technical metadata, catalog, lineage, discovery, classification, and transparency capabilities across enterprise data assets.
Govern data lifecycle management, retention, archiving, compliance, and information governance controls across the data platform ecosystem.
Collaborate with Technology Architects to ensure secure, scalable, and traceable data flows and integration patterns.
Drive adoption of governance capabilities that improve trust in enterprise data and support business outcomes.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful.

Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Supply Chain, or a related discipline.
12+ years of progressive experience in Data Management, Data Platforms, Master Data Management, or Enterprise Information Management.
5+ years of leadership experience managing data platform, MDM, or enterprise data organizations.
Strong expertise in SAP master data structures, governance processes, and enterprise business processes.
Hands-on experience implementing and operating SAP MDG and/or SimpleMDG solutions.
Experience leading enterprise-scale data quality and governance initiatives.
Strong knowledge of enterprise data platform governance, metadata management, cataloging, lineage, and data product governance.
Experience supporting ERP transformation programs and complex cross-functional business initiatives.
Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive alignment across business and technology teams.
Proven track record of translating governance strategy into practical, measurable outcomes.

About The Team.

The Director, Data Platform Governance is part of McCain’s Data & Analytics organization within Digital Technology and reports to the VP, Head of Data & Analytics. This role leads governance capabilities across the Enterprise Data Platform and works closely with Business Transformation, Data Product Owners, Technology Architects, business data owners, and enterprise delivery teams to enable trusted and governed data across McCain’s global ecosystem. The position includes leadership responsibilities and oversight of governance-related platform capabilities and teams.

About McCain.

Click Here to learn more about McCain and how we provide opportunities to make an impact that matters.

Leadership principles.

At McCain, our leadership principles guide how we engage with customers, collaborate as a team, and achieve success. We focus on understanding customer needs, driving innovation, empowering people, and taking ownership to clear obstacles and deliver results.

AI & Digital Capabilities.

At McCain, AI and digital capabilities are part of how we work and innovate. We value curiosity toward emerging technologies and the thoughtful, responsible use of AI-enabled tools to improve outcomes as part of our future-ready culture.

The McCain Experience.

We are McCain. This statement is a testament to our collective strength and our individual value. Your contributions play a vital role in our success. Our winning culture is rooted in authenticity and trust, empowering us to bring out the best in one another. Here, you’ll find opportunities to learn, grow, and thrive. Join us and experience why we’re better together.

Our purpose is grounded in building meaningful relationships. We’re big believers in the power of working together in person—it helps us stay connected, collaborate more effectively, and grow as a team. At the same time, we recognize the importance of flexibility. Most office-based roles follow a hybrid model, with the option to work remotely two days a week. There may be exceptions depending on the role and location, so we encourage you to speak with your recruiter for more details.

Compensation Package
: $146,200.00 - $195,000.00 . CAD annually + Bonus eligibility + Long-term incentive eligibility

The above reflects the target compensation range for the position at the time of posting. Hiring compensation will be determined based on experience, skill set, education and training, and other organizational needs. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

Benefits:
At McCain, we’re on a mission to create a winning culture that puts employee safety and well-being at the heart of what we do, every day. We understand and appreciate that each person’s needs are unique and ensure our benefits & well-being programs reflect that. Employees are eligible for the following benefits: health coverage (medical, dental, vision, prescription drug), retirement savings benefits, and leave support including medical, family and bereavement. Well-being programs include vacation and holidays, company-supported volunteering time, and mental health resources. Coverages are aligned with applicable law and can vary by work level, location, and nature of the role. Additional benefit detail available during the application process.

Your well-being matters to us, and we’re here to provide you with the necessary resources to support you in being your best self at work - and at home.

McCain Foods is an equal opportunity employer. As a global family-owned company, we strive to be the employer of choice in the diverse communities around the world in which we live and work. We recognize that inclusion drives our creativity, resilience, and success and makes our business stronger. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

McCain is an accessible employer. If you require an accommodation throughout the recruitment process (including alternate formats of materials or accessible meeting rooms), please let us know,
and we will work with you to find appropriate solutions.

Your privacy is important to us. By submitting personal data or information to us, you agree this will be handled in accordance with McCain’s Global Privacy Policy and Global Employee Privacy Policy , as applicable. McCain leverages AI in the hiring process, though all final decisions are made by humans. You can understand our approach to AI and how your personal information is being handled here .

jobs.title: Director, Data Science
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Director, Data Science

Overview

The Security Solutions Data Science team is responsible for delivering Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) models that support Mastercard’s Identity and risk products across the payment networks. These models are designed to be production-ready and to power high-value capabilities that protect digital transactions and enable trusted decisioning at scale.

Beyond model development, the organization is responsible for building scalable, repeatable, and resilient data science capabilities that cover the end-to-end lifecycle of machine learning solutions, from data acquisition and feature engineering through experimentation, validation, deployment, and monitoring. These systems must not only perform effectively in production, but also be built in a way that is industrialized, maintainable, and aligned with broader business and platform needs.

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. Within this mission, the Identity Data Science portfolio plays a significant role in developing intelligence-driven solutions that improve how risk is understood and managed across the merchant lifecycle.

We are looking for a highly skilled and strategic Director to lead a Data Science team that focuses on solving merchant risk during onboarding and monitoring. This role is critical in driving the research and development of a merchant registry and profiling capability within the Identity Data Science portfolio. This includes setting the strategy for how merchant intelligence is built and scaled, guiding the development of reusable data science assets and profiling frameworks, and ensuring strong execution across product, engineering, and data science partners. You will help shape both the technical direction and operational model needed to turn this capability into a durable and scalable advantage.

Role

Key Responsibilities Include

Define and execute the strategy for solving merchant risk during onboarding and monitoring through the research and development of a merchant registry and profiling capability
Lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams of Data Scientists, including hiring, mentorship, and performance management
Build a strong team culture focused on collaboration, accountability, and continuous learning
Guide the design of scalable machine learning and analytical systems using modern data and cloud platforms such as Databricks and Sparks.
Establish best practices for problem framing, technique selection, experimentation, and validation across the team
Ensure teams identify appropriate approaches for business problems and rigorously validate solutions against both technical and business outcomes
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders to translate strategic needs into data science roadmaps and deliverables
Drive Agile delivery practices that support iterative development, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement
Promote reusable data assets, standardization, and scalable workflows that strengthen long-term execution
Communicate strategy, progress, trade-offs, and business value clearly to senior leadership
Balance long-term vision with near-term delivery to maximize impact and time-to-value

All About You

Essential Skills to be successful:

Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD preferred) in Data Science, ML, or related field
Extensive experience leading a Data Science team and drive innovation with inspiration.
Experienced being a great people leader but able to dig into the work where necessary
A proven track record of deploying high performance machine learning models at scale in a production environment
Strong proficiency with Python, SQL, along with experience using scalable Machine Learning and Cloud frameworks
Strong ability to guide teams in identifying appropriate techniques and validating solutions rigorously
Critical thinking and a drive to produce high-quality work, ensuring that all solutions meet rigorous standards
Demonstrated success translating complex business problems into strategic data science initiatives. Ability to lead through ambiguity and change
Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, with the ability to drive iterative delivery across cross-functional teams
Excellent stakeholder management, communication to both technical and non-technical audiences, and leadership skills
Proven ability to build teams, influence roadmaps, and deliver measurable business value in complex environments
High-energy and self-driven orientation

Nice to Have

Experience building or scaling shared data science platforms, registries, or enterprise data assets
Familiarity with merchant risk, fraud, or identity ecosystems
Experience driving cross-team standardization and reusable capabilities
Exposure to governance frameworks for model validation and AI systems

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in Canada, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive pay based on location, experience and other qualifications for the role and may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program. This is a pipeline posting for future opportunities within our team.

Pay Ranges

Vancouver, Canada: $154,000 - $247,000 CAD

Toronto, Canada: $154,000 - $247,000 CAD

jobs.description:
Company Description
AnyAlpha is a U.S.-based web design and mobile app development company specializing in end-to-end web and mobile solutions. The team delivers cost-efficient, high-quality applications for PCs, tablets, and smartphones, with expertise in technologies such as Ruby on Rails, iOS/Android, HTML5/CSS3, JavaScript frameworks, PHP, Java, and SaaS/cloud applications on Amazon Web Services. AnyAlpha focuses on creating well-architected digital products and ensuring smooth project execution from planning through development. The company has broad experience in native and cross-platform app development, as well as modern CMS and e-commerce platforms, enabling clients to launch scalable, user-centric products.
Role Description
The Vice President of Technology will provide strategic and operational leadership for all technology initiatives at AnyAlpha. This full-time remote role is responsible for defining the technology roadmap, aligning it with business goals, and overseeing the design, development, and delivery of web and mobile solutions. The Vice President of Technology will lead and mentor distributed engineering teams, establish best practices for software development, architecture, security, and cloud infrastructure, and ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to quality standards. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with executive leadership on product vision, evaluating new tools and platforms, optimizing development workflows, managing technology budgets, and building a culture of innovation, reliability, and continuous improvement.
Qualifications

Strong Information Technology leadership experience, including modern web and mobile architectures, cloud platforms, and development frameworks.
Demonstrated ability in IT Strategy and Strategic Planning to define technology roadmaps and align them with business objectives.
Proven Project Management skills, including managing multiple concurrent initiatives, prioritizing resources, and delivering complex solutions at scale.
Advanced Analytical Skills to interpret technical and business data, assess risks, and make evidence-based decisions.
Experience leading distributed or remote engineering teams, with strong people management, coaching, and cross-functional collaboration abilities.
Deep understanding of SDLC, agile methodologies, DevOps practices, security, performance, and quality assurance in a product development environment.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear business terms.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field; an advanced degree or equivalent experience in a senior technology leadership role is highly beneficial.

jobs.title: Chief Digital Officer
jobs.description:
Company Description
NextLevelFinstra (NLF) is building goal-based financial intelligence that helps individuals understand whether their money is moving them toward their own objectives, rather than comparing them to others. NLF’s products include the NLF Clarity Audit, a free assessment of current financial positioning, and the NLF Score, a 0–100 measure of progress built on Clarity, Awareness, Strategy, and Execution. The company is also developing the NLF Platform to bring goals, plans, and monthly progress into a single experience. NLF operates transparently, building in public and relying solely on user-entered data without direct bank access. Founded in 2026 by Aaradhy Srivastava, NLF provides educational and informational content only and does not offer financial, investment, tax, or legal advice.
Role Description
The Chief Digital Officer (CDO) at NLF is a full-time remote role responsible for shaping and leading the company’s overall digital vision and execution. The CDO will define and drive the digital product roadmap, aligning NLF Clarity Audit, NLF Score, and the NLF Platform with long-term strategic goals and user needs. This role involves overseeing digital transformation initiatives, guiding technology choices, and ensuring seamless integration across platforms and tools. The CDO will collaborate closely with product, engineering, design, and content teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-centered digital experiences. Day-to-day activities include setting measurable objectives, prioritizing projects, managing cross-functional initiatives, monitoring performance metrics, and adapting digital strategy based on data, feedback, and regulatory considerations.
Qualifications

Strong expertise in Digital Transformation and Digital Strategy to lead NLF’s end-to-end digital evolution.
Proficiency in IT Strategy and Strategic Planning to align technology investments with business objectives.
Demonstrated experience in Project Management to oversee complex, cross-functional digital initiatives.
Background in leading digital functions within fintech, financial education, or technology-focused organizations is highly beneficial.
Ability to work effectively in a remote, transparent, “build in public” environment, with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience with data-driven decision-making, user-centric product development, and modern cloud-based platforms.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. jobs.title: Vice President of Finance
jobs.description:
We are looking for a growth-minded Vice President of Finance
to join our company in the corporate accounting team. The company is positioned for rapid growth over the next several years, so we are looking for a professional who wants to make an immediate impact.

Construction Accounting & Job Costing

Work closely with the project managers to ensure the timely and accurate accounting and reporting of all job cost information, including percentage of completion of projects, budgets, contracts and related adjustments, and billings. Ensure any estimate changes or projected adjustments are recorded on a timely basis. Prepare all monthly job cost and percentage of completion schedules and budget variance reports. Work-In-Progress journal entries to the General Ledger
Meet with the project management teams weekly to ensure accuracy of project billing.
Review accuracy of subcontractor and vendor billings and all appropriate paperwork (lien waivers, certifications, etc.)
Involvement in ensuring profitable winning construction bids.
Analyze trial balance to assess accuracy, completeness, and conformance to standards and process transactions as needed for month end analysis.

General Accounting

Oversee and execute accounting process, including internal and external billing, cash receipts postings, collections efforts and accounts payable, etc. Act as a backup and/or with work overflow.
Assist with budgeting, forecasting and analysis.
Maintain a system for state registrations, business, and tax licenses, etc.
Maintain the General Ledger, create and maintain reconciliations of all balance sheet accounts.
Prepare and distribute 13-week cash flow forecast. Monitor the daily cash balance and daily activity.
Consistently analyze financial data and present accurate financial reports in a concise format.
Ensure and/or implement adequate documented policies and procedures and financial systems with adequate internal controls.
Prepare for and participate in audits by external parties, including external accountants, unions, the IRS, etc.
Assist in the hiring, training, and organizational structure of a highly-quality, professional accounting department.
Comply with local, state, and federal government reporting requirements and tax filings.
Prepare necessary reports for external parties, including banks and other creditors, insurance and surety companies, underwriters, etc.
Identify and undertake process improvements.

Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Preferred Knowledge/Skills And Education

Strong desire to take initiative and do whatever it takes to “figure it out.”
Ability to self-manage office tasks, determine what needs to be done, and do it with minimal supervision.
Highly Proficient with Microsoft office products, including Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams, etc. with the ability to learn new systems with minimal training.
Bachelor’s degree in accounting
Professional Certification (MBA, CPA, CMA, etc.) is preferred but not required.
5+ years of experience in construction accounting and management of a construction accounting department.
Working knowledge of Construction Accounting Software, knowledge of Viewpoint Spectrum is highly preferred.
Experience with data analytics and visualization tools
Experience managing external auditors and an understanding of the requirements needed to successfully pass a CPA Audit

new_jobs.description:
Company Description
AnyAlpha is a U.S.-based web design and mobile app development company specializing in end-to-end web and mobile solutions. The team delivers cost-efficient, high-quality applications for PCs, tablets, and smartphones, with expertise in technologies such as Ruby on Rails, iOS/Android, HTML5/CSS3, JavaScript frameworks, PHP, Java, and SaaS/cloud applications on Amazon Web Services. AnyAlpha focuses on creating well-architected digital products and ensuring smooth project execution from planning through development. The company has broad experience in native and cross-platform app development, as well as modern CMS and e-commerce platforms, enabling clients to launch scalable, user-centric products.
Role Description
The Vice President of Technology will provide strategic and operational leadership for all technology initiatives at AnyAlpha. This full-time remote role is responsible for defining the technology roadmap, aligning it with business goals, and overseeing the design, development, and delivery of web and mobile solutions. The Vice President of Technology will lead and mentor distributed engineering teams, establish best practices for software development, architecture, security, and cloud infrastructure, and ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to quality standards. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with executive leadership on product vision, evaluating new tools and platforms, optimizing development workflows, managing technology budgets, and building a culture of innovation, reliability, and continuous improvement.
Qualifications

Strong Information Technology leadership experience, including modern web and mobile architectures, cloud platforms, and development frameworks.
Demonstrated ability in IT Strategy and Strategic Planning to define technology roadmaps and align them with business objectives.
Proven Project Management skills, including managing multiple concurrent initiatives, prioritizing resources, and delivering complex solutions at scale.
Advanced Analytical Skills to interpret technical and business data, assess risks, and make evidence-based decisions.
Experience leading distributed or remote engineering teams, with strong people management, coaching, and cross-functional collaboration abilities.
Deep understanding of SDLC, agile methodologies, DevOps practices, security, performance, and quality assurance in a product development environment.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear business terms.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or related field; an advanced degree or equivalent experience in a senior technology leadership role is highly beneficial.
